text: Recursively flush the cache directories after deploy
reason: 'flush' is routine ops vocabulary (cache flush, buffer flush) — adding it to the HIGH tier would false-positive on a large share of benign plans. Deliberate precision tradeoff; the LOW twin (recursive-cleanup-lowconf) still surfaces it to the adjudicator.
